Rl.bar_b_note: The blue-grey translucent panel fits the UI direction, but the small salmon-on-teal recipe sublines and tiny hints fall short of Palworld's crisp high-contrast HUD hierarchy, and the dark rain-grey world behind it has no Valheim-style mood.

Yg.bar_b_note: A's furred, tusked boar is close to the naturalistic owner bar but stands no taller than the 1.80 m trainer and floats above its shadow in faint mid; B's smooth clay/piggy-bank boar with moss decals would look like a different, toy-like game beside Palworld.

Cd.bar_b_note: A warm, readable elder villager with clear face and eyes and a key-art-matched green/brown palette carries it, though he is more Pixar-cartoon than the naturalistic creature line.

Se.bar_b_note: A murky, enclosed courtyard of dark-green ground and banner walls with a sliver of sky gives no daylight, depth or atmosphere; it sinks on light and on flat orange foreground crates.

Ji.bar_b_note: B's aftermaths (toppled banners, opened cage, smoke from a struck camp) tell a story, but the smeared, low-res ground and stone-wall textures, sparse ground cover and flat grade sit well below Palworld's density and finish.

Jn.bar_b_note: Identical in substance to Se: a dark, boxed-in courtyard with no sky, fog or time-of-day grade, and glowing orange crate placeholders right in front of the camera.

Dr.bar_b_note: A wall of trunks with no visible watch structure, ridgeline or distance gives no landmark or depth, and the camera sits inside a trunk in A's reverse frame, so it never reads as a Palworld-grade vista.

Xh.bar_b_note: The bright sky and lush grass are close to the Meadows palette, but a uniform grass carpet with lone trees and a tiny, unlit stronghold on the horizon reads emptier and flatter than Palworld's grouped, landmarked fields.

top_changes.change: Give the Meadows stronghold a tall lit hero keep (towers, braziers, warm window light) that dominates the approach from distance, and open the courtyard to sky and daylight in Se/Jn

Re-light and recompose the stronghold courtyard and Ridgeline Watch cameras: lift exposure, add sky/fog depth and sun shafts, move cameras out of trunks and pillars, remove or retexture the flat orange foreground crates
Break the uniform grass carpet into groves, edges and clearings with shrub and rock clusters, and replace the smeared low-res ground textures seen in Ji and Xh
